ActionRun.description: What the Hub stored for one dispatched action.
ActionRun.title: ActionRun

ActionRunStatus.description: What the Hub stores. `lost`: sent, but no result came back; never resent.
ActionRunStatus.title: ActionRunStatus

AgendaEntry.description:
One thing in the agenda. `blocks` = it takes up time (used for conflicts and free
time); a Canvas deadline is a point in time and does not block.
AgendaEntry.title: AgendaEntry

ChatProposal.description:
An action the assistant proposes; nothing happens until the user confirms it
(the web then calls POST /triage/handle with these ids).
ChatProposal.title: ChatProposal

Credential.description: What the Hub tells about a credential: never the secret itself.
Credential.title: Credential

CredentialPut.description: Body of PUT /credentials/{name}. SecretStr keeps the value out of reprs and logs.
CredentialPut.title: CredentialPut

EntrySummary.description: The AI summary of a mail entry (ADR 0027).
EntrySummary.title: EntrySummary

EventPatch.description: Replace an event's fields; `version` guards against overwriting a newer edit.
EventPatch.title: EventPatch

GradeLine.description: What the work not graded yet needs, on average, for the whole course to reach `target`.
GradeLine.title: GradeLine

expires_at.description: Timezone-aware; the memory is hidden from search after it.
expires_at.title: Expires At

source_ref.description: Where it came from: a URL, a file, a chat.
source_ref.title: Source Ref

rank.description: bm25 score (lower is better); null for substring-only matches
rank.title: Rank

MemoryUpdate.description: A correction: send only what changes, plus the `version` you last read.
MemoryUpdate.title: MemoryUpdate

PairResponse.description: The token is returned exactly once and never stored by the Hub.
PairResponse.title: PairResponse

PairingCode.description: Shown to the user once; the Hub keeps only its hash.
PairingCode.title: PairingCode

Selector.description: All conditions must hold (AND). Kept tiny on purpose: no regex, OR or wildcards.
Selector.title: Selector

version.description: The task version you last read.
version.title: Version

execution_mode.description: Omitted: human_led if tags contain 'course:CIS', else collaborate.

WorkspaceCreate.description: Bound to exactly one of a project or a task.
WorkspaceCreate.title: WorkspaceCreate
